typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID as string,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_CD as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		AFFILIATE_MEMBER_EFF_DT as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(4), @P_STARTDATE DATETIME, @P_ENDDATE DATETIME, @STARTDATE DATETIME, @ENDDATE DATETIME, @ENTITYTYPE_IID BIGINT SET @CALLLIST_CD = \'701\' SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = GETDATE() ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY,-7,@ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE  SELECT @ENTITYTYPE_IID = ENTITYTYPE_IID FROM PDS_ENTITYTYPE WHERE ENTITYTYPE_CD = \'AFFILIATE\'  DECLARE @temp_Members TABLE (MEMBER_IID BIGINT) INSERT INTO @temp_Members (MEMBER_IID) SELECT DISTINCT CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = @CALLLIST_CD 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 		AND ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD = \'DELXATTEMPTS\' 	 SELECT AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID,AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_EFF_DT,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN @temp_Members T ON CL.CALLLIST_CD = @CALLLIST_CD 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID = T.MEMBER_IID 		AND CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID 		AND CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITYTYPE_IID = @ENTITYTYPE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = T.MEMBER_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CREATE_DT >= CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 1 	INNER JOIN PDS_AFFILIATE_MEMBER AM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID ORDER BY AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDS701WeeklyMaxAttempts
PDS701WeeklyMaxAttempts derive(AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID_Unicode = toString(AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID),
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE_Unicode = toString(DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE),
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = toString(DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION),
		DISPOSITIONCODE_CD_Unicode = toString(DISPOSITIONCODE_CD)) ~> ConverttoUnicode
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> SimplyHealthWorksheet
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> BetterHealthWorksheet
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CompletionsWorksheet
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> RemovalsWorksheet
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MedicareAttemptsWorksheet
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CompletionsWorksheet
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
